name: KLHalf 2026
short_description: KLHalf 2026 is on Sunday 15 November 2026 at Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur, over 21.1 km.
ai_summary: KLHalf 2026 is a single-distance 21 km race organised by Score, starting from Dataran Merdeka in Kuala Lumpur on 15 November 2026. The flag-off is at 4:30 am with a cut-off of 4 hours 30 minutes, and there is a separate High Performance start pen for elite runners chasing podium places. Race kit collection is on 13 and 14 November at The Starling Mall, Damansara Utama.

faqs.question: What time does KLHalf 2026 start and what is the cut-off?
faqs.answer: The flag-off is at 4:30 am on Sunday 15 November 2026 at Dataran Merdeka. The cut-off is 4 hours 30 minutes, and runners who finish after it are disqualified and do not receive finisher items.

faqs.question: Who can enter KLHalf 2026?
faqs.answer: The only distance is 21 km, and runners must be at least 16 years old on 15 November 2026. The registration fee shown on the event page is RM148, and a Quad Challenge team category is open to teams of four 21 km runners.
